recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any desired rename or wording overhaul for the existing element should be handled as a new substantive tracker because R5/R6-era source and downstream usage already use Requirements.statement.conditionality.
issue_request: FHIR-39058 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked for a boolean attribute on Requirements.statement to indicate conditional requirements, with resolution text proposing statement.conditional and rendering-oriented guidance.
initial_application: Commit 9529fd0680d464a377f07cbd49144bcf02190036, titled "FHIR-39058 How to do \"IF\" conditional statements?", added Requirements.statement.conditionality as a 0..1 boolean to source/requirements/structuredefinition-Requirements.xml. Later Requirements cleanup preserved the element and corrected a spelling typo in its definition.
additional_context: Requirements is active in source/fhir.ini, assigned to FHIR-I, and marked normative. FHIR-I minutes confirm the issue was voted Persuasive on 2022-12-05 after earlier submitter-input discussion. A later public Zulip thread from the original reporter references downstream rendering of statement.conditionality as a conditional pill, supporting preservation of the applied element name.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already provides the requested boolean and conveys the approved semantics; renaming the shipped element from conditionality to the exact Jira proposal conditional would be a breaking conformance change not justified by this reconciliation.
